newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end up on investor buying, weak output data.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end up on investor buying, weak output data.

text.p: *Key September 10-year JGB futures ended higher due to investor buying of cash bonds and weak industrial output data.
*Industrial output in June fell 3.1 percent from May. This was slightly stronger than earlier rumours of four percent month-on-month fall, but still considered to be weak, traders said.
